caption: Without the plugin, Obsidian shows the backticks, stars and tildes of an alias as text.
eval: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); await app.plugins.disablePlugin('wikilink-alias-markup'); app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().rebuildView(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { await app.plugins.enablePlugin('wikilink-alias-markup'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().rebuildView(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: With the plugin, Live Preview shows inline code, italic, bold, strikethrough and highlight in the alias.
eval: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<50 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line [class*="wam-"]').length<5;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line [class*="wam-"]').length; if (n<5) throw new Error('live preview marks: '+n); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The page preview works on the formatted alias.
eval: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview'}}); for (let i=0;i<50 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view .wam-alias').length<6;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view .wam-alias').length; if (n<6) throw new Error('reading links: '+n); const el=document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .markdown-reading-view a.internal-link code'); const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+5,clientY:r.top+5})); for (let i=0;i<30 && !document.querySelector('.hover-popover');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!document.querySelector('.hover-popover')) throw new Error('no page preview'); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.hover-popover').forEach(p => p.remove()); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: math in an alias, here in Live Preview.
eval: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['wikilink-alias-markup']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('wikilink-alias-markup-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<80 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .wam-math mjx-container').length<2;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .wam-math mjx-container').length<2) throw new Error('no math'); document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .wam-math').scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The settings: Live Preview on or off, and math in aliases (Pro).
